versions.content: If a SDU has been successfully received, the function Lin_GetStatus shall store the SDU in a shadow buffer or memory mapped LIN Hardware receive buffer referenced by Lin_SduPtr. The buffer will only be valid and must be read until the next Lin_SendFrame function call.
